data.name: Backpack Guardian
data.detailed_description:
Spells, Loot and Action

You are the last guardian and the last hope of your people as shadows spread across the land. Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, spells, and powerful relics. Each run offers new builds, new choices, and new ways to survive.

Fight through hordes of enemies with unique mechanics and tactics. Manage your mana and stamina, dodge deadly attacks, unleash spells, and adapt your build before the darkness overwhelms you.

Inventory Management

Your true power lies in your backpack.

Every item you carry can change your fate. Strategically position and rotate weapons, armor, spells, relics, and crafting materials to make the most of your limited space. Items can interact with nearby gear, amplify stats, trigger synergies, or unlock hidden effects.

Some spells must be socketed into weapons or armor before they can be unleashed, while others grow stronger when placed beside the right items. A single rearranged item can transform your entire build.

Choose Your Adventure

Climb a procedurally generated map by choosing your route upward. Battle enemies and elites, open treasure chests, rest at campfires, visit merchants, and uncover secret encounters.

Choose carefully, adapt constantly, and survive through three deadly Acts. Every run is different: new loot, new talents, new challenges, and new build possibilities.

How far can you ascend?
    

Features

  • Backpack Synergies
    Items influence nearby gear. Position and rotate your loot to unlock hidden bonuses, powerful stat boosts, and game-changing multipliers.

  • Spells and Attunements
    Socket powerful spells into weapons, armor, or jewelry to unlock unique abilities and build-defining effects.

  • Procedural Talent Trees
    Every run generates a new character progression path, forcing you to adapt your strategy and discover fresh builds.

  • Endless Loot Variety
    Discover procedurally generated items with affixes, blessings, curses, attunements, and crafting upgrades.

  • Weapons and Playstyles
    Fight with bows, swords, staves, hammers, claymores, and more. Each weapon type supports a distinct combat style.

  • Crafting and Rare Finds
    Merge crafting materials, discover runes, and seek out hidden merchants to forge powerful equipment.

  • Dynamic Combat
    Manage mana and stamina while dodging, blocking, casting, and striking in fast-paced encounters against enemies with unique mechanics.

  • Randomized Adventures
    Explore three Acts of branching paths filled with enemies, elites, campfires, treasures, merchants, and secret encounters.

  • High Replayability With randomized loot, talent trees, maps, and item synergies, every run creates a different story.

data.short_description: Backpack Guardian is an action roguelike where your inventory is your build. Rotate and arrange weapons, armor, spells, relics, blessings, and cursed loot to trigger synergies, stack multipliers, and survive three Acts of fast-paced combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD HD 7970
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
